[[File:Ciridium.png|thumb|right|Ciridium]]
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Beskar'' is enormously strong, able to deflect blaster bolts and even lightsaber blades. Yet it is light and flexible, particularly when forged with carbon and ciridium.|Tor Vizsla, ''Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad''|<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
'''Ciridium''' was a substance included in the [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armors]].<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> The substance was noted in ''[[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad]]'', a manifesto of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] Mandalorian splinter group. The document was supposedly [[Author/Legends|written]] by the movement's [[Secret Mandalore|leader]], [[Tor Vizsla]]&mdash;although the Death Watch's opponent [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] doubted its authenticity&mdash;and was eventually included in the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]'' by Jango's son, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="BHC" />
